title: Russian Double-Strike Drones Kill Mother and 9-Year-Old Son in Sumy Region's Buryn
detail: Russian forces struck a private residential house in the Buryn community, Sumy region, with two jet-powered attack UAVs early on August 14. A 29-year-old woman and her 9-year-old son were killed at the scene; four others — including the boy's father and grandmother — were hospitalized with severe burns. The strike caused extensive structural damage and a fire. Across the wider Sumy region over the preceding 24 hours, Russian forces launched 39 attacks on 28 settlements using guided aerial bombs, attack drones, FPV drones, artillery, mortars, and rocket systems, killing one more person and injuring five others.

title: Russia Drops Eight Guided Aerial Bombs on Kramatorsk and Bilenke, Killing One, Injuring 15–18
detail: Russian forces struck Kramatorsk and the nearby village of Bilenke with eight guided aerial bombs (reported as FAB-250s) between 20:30 and 20:56 local time on the night of August 13–14. A direct hit on a residential apartment block ignited a fire that spread through several stories. Donetsk Regional Military Administration head Vadym Filashkin reported 1 killed and 15 wounded (other outlets reported up to 18 injured); emergency services worked through the night on rescue and firefighting operations.

title: Ukraine Strikes Ust-Luga Baltic Oil Port With 54 Drones, Damaging Two Processing Plants
detail: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck Russia's Ust-Luga oil export terminal in Leningrad Oblast overnight on August 14 with a wave of 54 long-range drones, sparking a fire and damaging two processing plants according to Ukraine's General Staff. Leningrad Oblast Governor Alexander Drozdenko confirmed damage and a fire at the port, which was extinguished within hours. It was at least the sixth Ukrainian strike on Ust-Luga — one of Russia's largest Baltic Sea oil-export hubs — in 2026 alone, part of Kyiv's sustained campaign against Russian energy export infrastructure.
